import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier, RandomForestClassifier
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Preprocessing function
def clean_text(text):
    if text is None or not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    text = text.replace("\\n", " ").replace("\\t", " ").replace("\\r", " ")
    text = text.replace('\\"', '"').replace("\\\\", "\\")
    text = text.lower().strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}", "", text)
    # Remove HTML tags
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    return text


train["Comment_Clean"] = train["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test["Comment_Clean"] = test["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Extract target and features at once
X_raw = train["Comment_Clean"].values
y = train["Insult"].values
date = train["Date"].values

# Split training data into train/val for unbiased validation
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, y_train, y_val, train_date, val_date = train_test_split(
    X_raw, y, date, train_size=0.8, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Text-level TF-IDF features
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 4),
    max_features=10000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
)
X_train_word = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_word = vectorizer_word.transform(X_val_raw)
X_test_word = vectorizer_word.transform(test["Comment_Clean"])

# Character n-grams
vectorizer_char_uni = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(1, 1), max_features=500, min_df=2, max_df=0.9
)
vectorizer_char_bi = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 3), max_features=10000, min_df=2, max_df=0.9
)
X_train_char_uni = vectorizer_char_uni.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_char_uni = vectorizer_char_uni.transform(X_val_raw)
X_test_char_uni = vectorizer_char_uni.transform(test["Comment_Clean"])

X_train_char_bi = vectorizer_char_bi.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_char_bi = vectorizer_char_bi.transform(X_val_raw)
X_test_char_bi = vectorizer_char_bi.transform(test["Comment_Clean"])

# Combined TF-IDF features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char_uni, X_train_char_bi])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char_uni, X_val_char_bi])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char_uni, X_test_char_bi])


# Enhanced targeted linguistic features for insults
def extract_insult_features(text):
    features = [0.0] * 12

    # 1-5: Targeting patterns (insults are personal)
    if isinstance(text, str) and len(text) > 0:
        text_lower = text.lower()

        # Direct second-person pronouns (YOU, you, your) - personal attacks
        you_count = len(
            re.findall(r"\b(you|yours?|yourself?|yourselves)\b", text_lower)
        )
        you_density = you_count / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1)
        features[0] = you_density

        # Direct name mentions (personal targeting)
        name_pattern = (
            r"\b[a-z]{2,20}\b\s+[a-z]{2,}\s*you\b|\b[a-z]{2,20}\b\s+[a-z]{3,10}"
        )
        name_hits = len(re.findall(name_pattern, text_lower, re.IGNORECASE))
        features[1] = float(name_hits / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1))

        # @ mentions (directing at specific users)
        at_mentions = len(re.findall(r"@\w+", text))
        features[2] = float(at_mentions / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1))

        # Direct accusation patterns (name + insult structure)
        accusation_pattern = r"\b[0-9a-zA-Z_-]+\s+(you|your)\s+\b(fool|idiot|stupid|shit|moron|asshole|bastard|puss|fuck|crap|waste)\b"
        accusation_count = len(
            re.findall(accusation_pattern, text_lower, re.IGNORECASE)
        )
        features[3] = float(accusation_count / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1))

        # Insult intensifiers (re: reall, very, so, damn, fucking)
        intensifiers = re.findall(
            r"(really|reall|very|so|damn|fucking|bastard|shut|fuck|crap|shit|ass|moron|idiot)",
            text_lower,
        )
        features[4] = float(len(intensifiers) / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1))

        # 6-8: Aggressive markers
        # Multiple consecutive letters indicating shouting
        shout_pattern = r"\b[A-Z]{3,}\b"
        shout_count = len(re.findall(shout_pattern, text))
        total_caps = len([w for w in text.split() if w and any(c.isupper() for c in w)])
        shout_ratio = shout_count / max(total_caps, 1)
        features[5] = float(shout_ratio)

        # Multiple question marks/commas (anger pattern)
        question_marks = text.count("?")
        comma_marks = text.count(",")
        punctuation_density = (question_marks + comma_marks) / max(
            len(text.split()) + 1, 1
        )
        features[6] = float(punctuation_density)

        # Exclamation density (aggressive punctuation)
        exclamation_count = text.count("!")
        exclamation_ratio = exclamation_count / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1)
        features[7] = float(exclamation_ratio)

        # Multiple punctuation in sequence
        multi_punct = len(re.findall(r"[.!?]{2,}", text))
        multi_punct_ratio = multi_punct / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1)
        features[8] = float(multi_punct_ratio)

        # 9-11: Specific insult vocabulary
        # Direct profanity
        profanity_words = re.findall(
            r"(fuck|fucked|fucking|shut|cunt|faggot|bitch|slut|whore|pussy|asshole)",
            text_lower,
        )
        profanity_density = len(profanity_words) / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1)
        features[9] = float(profanity_density)

        # Targeted profanity (adjective use like "you're a")
        targeted_pattern = r"(you|your)\s+(are|is)\s+(\w+)\s+(a/an/the|an|a)"
        targeted_hits = len(re.findall(targeted_pattern, text_lower, re.IGNORECASE))
        features[10] = float(targeted_hits / max(len(text.split()) + 1, 1))

        # 11: First person singularity (attacking from self to other)
        first_person = len(re.findall(r"\b(i|me|my|mine|myself)\b", text_lower))
        features[11] = float(first_person)

    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)


# Combine features properly
X_train_meta = np.array(
    [extract_insult_features(t) for t in X_train_raw], dtype=np.float32
)
X_val_meta = np.array([extract_insult_features(t) for t in X_val_raw], dtype=np.float32)
X_test_meta = np.array(
    [extract_insult_features(t) for t in test["Comment_Clean"]], dtype=np.float32
)

# Combine features properly
X_train_full = hstack([X_train_combined, X_train_meta])
X_val_full = hstack([X_val_combined, X_val_meta])
X_test_full = hstack([X_test_combined, X_test_meta])

# Train models on training split for unbiased validation
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=350,
    max_depth=10,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.9,
    min_samples_split=20,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    validation_fraction=0.1,
    n_iter_no_change=10,
)
gb_model.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=600,
    max_depth=16,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    verbose=0,
)
rf_model.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=600,
    max_depth=14,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=80,
    min_child_samples=15,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbosity=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    force_row_wise=True,
)
lgb_model.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

# Validation predictions on held-out data
gb_val_pred = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val_full)[:, 1]
rf_val_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val_full)[:, 1]
lgb_val_pred = lgb_model.predict_proba(X_val_full)[:, 1]

ensemble_val_pred = 0.40 * gb_val_pred + 0.30 * rf_val_pred + 0.30 * lgb_val_pred
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Final models on training data for submission
final_gb = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=400,
    max_depth=12,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.9,
    min_samples_split=20,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    validation_fraction=0.1,
    n_iter_no_change=10,
)
final_gb.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

final_rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=700,
    max_depth=18,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
final_rf.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

final_lgb = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=700,
    max_depth=14,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=80,
    min_child_samples=15,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbosity=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)
final_lgb.fit(X_train_full, y_train)

# Test predictions
gb_test_pred = final_gb.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]
rf_test_pred = final_rf.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]
lgb_test_pred = final_lgb.predict_proba(X_test_full)[:, 1]

# Final ensemble predictions
y_test_pred = 0.40 * gb_test_pred + 0.30 * rf_test_pred + 0.30 * lgb_test_pred

# Save submission with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Comment": test["Comment"], "Date": test["Date"], "Insult": y_test_pred}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
